myths.myth: Myth: 'The Constitution is just dry legal text that doesn't affect my daily Gen-Z life.'
myths.fact: Fact: Article 21 protects your digital privacy, Article 19 protects your right to speak up online, and Article 14 ensures equal education! The Constitution is your personal shield every single day.

myths.myth: Myth: 'Democracy is only about voting once every 5 years.'
myths.fact: Fact: Article 51A(h) makes it a Fundamental Duty for every young citizen to develop scientific temper, humanism, and the spirit of reform & questioning daily!

myths.myth: Myth: 'Minority reservation rights harm equal opportunity.'
myths.fact: Fact: Affirmative action levels the playing field for historically oppressed & backward communities. True equality means uplifting those denied equal access for centuries!
